membership_rule: every shared synonym is of kind 'dyntaxa_derived'
note: Immutable review input. Membership is pinned to the release and source archives below; it approves nothing and never extends to taxa in a later Dyntaxa export. A candidate name only suggests the pair; the evidence class is graded from both sources' published synonymy. shared_synonyms lists at most 10 names; shared_synonym_count is exact.

synonym_kinds.accepted_name_reauthored: the canonical name is either accepted name itself, under another authorship
synonym_kinds.dyntaxa_derived: otherwise ordinary, but every COL usage behind it comes from the COL source that is Dyntaxa (see dyntaxa_col_source): COL republishes Dyntaxa's assertion, so the two sources do not independently corroborate it
synonym_kinds.illegitimate: Dyntaxa nomenclaturalStatus 'illegitimum' or 'rejiciendum', the authorship carries 'nom. illeg.', or a COL usage's col:remarks/col:nameRemarks carries 'nom. illeg.' or 'later homonym'
synonym_kinds.interpretation_qualified: a misapplied COL usage (col:status 'misapplied'), or the authorship carries a sensu-style qualifier ('sensu', 's.', 'ss.', 'auct.'). Dyntaxa's misapplied usages never reach this test: they are not synonymy and are excluded when the archive is read
synonym_kinds.name_variant: no structured status applies, but the name is almost spelled like either accepted name: same word count once hyphens are removed, and every word, genus included, within Levenshtein distance 2
synonym_kinds.not_validly_published: Dyntaxa nomenclaturalStatus 'invalidum' or 'nudum', COL col:nameStatus 'not established', the authorship carries 'nom. nud.' or 'nom. inval.', or a COL usage's col:remarks/col:nameRemarks carries 'nom. nud.', 'nom. inval.' or 'published without a valid description'
synonym_kinds.ordinary: meets none of the tests above
synonym_kinds.pro_parte: COL col:status 'ambiguous synonym', or the authorship carries 'p.p.' or 'pro parte' (Dyntaxa's proParteSynonym usages are excluded when the archive is read)
synonym_kinds.unauthored: the authorship is empty, so the match is on the name alone
synonym_kinds.unpublished: COL col:nameStatus 'manuscript', or the authorship or a COL usage's col:remarks/col:nameRemarks carries 'ined' or 'nom. herb.'
